title: Freedom Automotive Dealerships
services: Mechanical · Electrical · Plumbing · Building Automation · Fire Protection
overview: Full MEP design for three new dealerships — Ford, Kia, and Volkswagen — built as a campus where the Ford building acts as the hub and sub-feeds the others, requiring interconnecting utilities. The Ford store uses waste-oil boilers and radiant in-floor heat; MEI also designed a related stand-alone Kia dealership in Clarksburg.
